text:
nina: 10m heads-up for release/2026 surge cutover. plan = apply small routing + add NAT fallback in case of AZ egress flaps. will separate IAM changes to a later window.

carl: ack. i'll own the nat fallback apply and watch state.

infra-bot: scan: detected mixed module versions: modules/net@v1.3.0 vs modules/net@v1.4.0 in staging. recommend aligning before apply to avoid resource recreation.

nina: hmm. i thought we standardized. carl can you pin the module ref in the workspace override?

carl: doing a quick workspace pin, pushing override. command: `terraform init -upgrade=false` then set module source to `git::ssh://git@.../modules/net?ref=v1.3.0`

deploy-bot: preflight started: `terraform plan -var-file=surge.tfvars -target=module.net.nat_fallback`

deploy-bot: preflight: plan OK but remote state shows one orphaned route resource not in config (state drift). rule: state-orphan-detection.

carl: that's from an old canary test. i can remove the orphan via `terraform state rm` but prefer to import if it's still live.

nina: do we have time to import? if not, revert by state rm and document in ticket.

carl: importing takes ~2m. i'll run a quick import and re-run plan.

deploy-bot: lock acquired. running `terraform import module.net.aws_route.orphan r-rt-12345`

deploy-bot: import success. re-running plan.

deploy-bot: plan: add 1 aws_nat_gateway, change 2 route attachments. no IAM changes.

carl: applying now:```
terraform apply -target=module.net.nat_fallback -auto-approve
```

deploy-bot: apply streaming: `apply: 1 added, 2 changed, 0 destroyed`

deploy-bot: ERROR during apply: `EBS quota exceeded when creating nat EIP allocation`

nina: ugh. quota spike. can we fallback to smaller nat or re-use existing EIP?

carl: i see an unused EIP in staging account: eip-08c. attempting to reuse by patching vars then reapply.

deploy-bot: re-run apply after var update.

deploy-bot: apply streaming: `apply: 1 added, 2 changed`

deploy-bot: apply complete. NAT created reusing eip-08c. routes updated.

nina: nice recovery. starting surge traffic shift 0->30% in 3 steps. ops-oncall will monitor.

ops-oncall: watching. PD threshold: 5xx > 0.5% sustained for 3m. will page infra if breached. also enabled extra logging for route flaps.

10m_later_bot: monitor: 5xx 0.02%, p95 latency +6% (within noise). all green.

release-coordinator: adding note to release docs: "NAT fallback applied; orphan route imported. IAM changes deferred; module refs pinned to v1.3.0 for the surge."

nina: follow-ups: carl to open PR to align module refs across envs and raise quota request for EIP pool; ops-oncall to add EIP quota check to preflight.

carl: on it. PR and quota ticket created: #3142. i also added a short rollback snippet to the ticket:```
# rollback nat fallback
terraform apply -target=aws_route.table_backup -var-file=rollback.tfvars -auto-approve
```

nina: closing thread for daytime window. we'll reopen if PD fires or for IAM night window. :lock:
